message:
file-granularity graph is ~827,583 input tokens (> --max-input-tokens 180,000) — a single fair LLM call is not possible (eval §6.2). Choose one:
  --granularity target     score the target-level graph instead (small, fits one call)
  --chunk                  (not yet implemented) partition in graph-partitioned chunks
  --allow-oversize         send anyway and let the provider truncate (records the loss)
A graph that does not fit one context is itself evidence for the deterministic-first thesis — record it as a limitation, do not fake a number.
